description: This source file manages extender associated devices, including harvesting device data, maintaining linked lists of associated devices, and controlling polling and reporting periods for associated device data collection in a network extender context.

methods.name: isvalueinarray_idw
methods.description: Checks if a given ULONG value exists within an array of ULONGs.

methods.name: SetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables the harvesting of associated device data, starting or stopping the harvesting thread accordingly.

methods.name: GetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of device data harvesting.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for associated device data collection.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current reporting period.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling interval for device data collection and signals the harvesting thread.

methods.name: ValidateIDWPeriod
methods.description: Validates if a given interval is within the allowed set of periods.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current polling interval.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default reporting period.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling interval.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default polling interval.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the current TTL override value.

methods.name: SetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the TTL override value.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default TTL override value.

methods.name: add_to_list_idw
methods.description: Adds a new associated device data entry to the linked list.

methods.name: print_list_idw
methods.description: Prints the linked list of associated device data for debugging.

methods.name: delete_list_idw
methods.description: Deletes the entire linked list of associated device data.

methods.name: GetWiFiApGetAssocDevicesData
methods.description: Retrieves associated WiFi devices connected to extenders and populates linked lists.

methods.name: StartAssociatedDeviceHarvesting
methods.description: Thread function that periodically harvests associated device data and manages reporting.
